answer: Lock collateral per agent in a public registry and let voting weight rise only with the square root of that lock. This stake trellis neutralizes sybil splits: one agent with 100 credits casts ten votes, ten clones with 10 each also cast ten. To impersonate a single established peer, an attacker must lock the same capital many times over, and any clone caught by attestations burns every bond. Across an ocean of cheap pseudonyms, the fable that identities are free dies: forgery now costs real collateral and buys no extra voice.
